data.description:
User reports that on mobile or smaller browser widths the hero opening animation no longer animates — the wireframe nodes aren't moving around.

Relevant code: src/components/interactive/HeroBrandVisual.tsx (rAF loop, IntersectionObserver gating, perfTier detection) and src/lib/hero-canvas.ts (drawRightPlane wireframe network animation).

Suspects to investigate:
- detectPerfTier() returns 'low' when w < 768 || (w < 1024 && isTouch). On low tier the loop skips every other frame — verify s.frame still increments and reveal animations still tick.
- The entrance animation in HeroBrandVisual loop() runs only while elapsed >= DELAY_MS && s.rotation < 1. After completion does the wireNetwork keep updating?
- On mobile, signal dots and cross markers are skipped (line 449, 470 in hero-canvas.ts). Verify edges/nodes themselves still draw and move.
- isVisibleRef gating via IntersectionObserver — if the threshold isn't met on small viewports the loop returns early and stops animating.
- Canvas resize: handleResize() rebuilds wireNetwork on every resize. orientationchange handler may rebuild it mid-animation and reset reveal state.

Reproduce in DevTools mobile emulation first to see what 'not animating' actually means (no wireframe at all? wireframe drawn but static? animation runs once and freezes?).
data.title: Hero brand visual — wireframe nodes don't animate on mobile / smaller viewport

data.body: Reported issue (2026-04-29): hero animation is fully static on mobile — nodes/vectors don't move at all. Verify on viewport <768px.

Reviewed PR #99 with fresh context. Verdict: PASS.

Scope: only src/lib/hero-canvas.ts and src/components/interactive/HeroBrandVisual.tsx touched, exactly as planned.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Autonomous drift implemented as planned — driftT = s.frame * 0.012, driftAmp = isLow ? 4 : 2, with cos(t) on px and sin(1.3t)*0.7 on py. With mouseX/mouseY pinned at 0.5 (touch), the parallax becomes pure Lissajous wander of ~+/-4px on mobile, +/-2px on desktop. s.frame++ confirmed in drawFrame (line 504), so the drift advances every animated frame whether or not the mouse moves.
2. Desktop behaviour unchanged — driftAmp=2 keeps autonomous wander imperceptible vs the +/-6px mouse parallax.
3. Signal-dot gate removed; cross markers stay gated as planned. Comment in code matches reasoning.
4. Edge alpha amplitude bumped 0.7+/-0.15 -> 0.65+/-0.25; node alpha 0.35+/-0.1 -> 0.3+/-0.18. Matches plan exactly; averages preserved.
5. orientationchange listener leak fixed by hoisting onOrientation into a named const inside the effect, and removeEventListener now references the same function. Cleanup symmetry verified.
6. pnpm lint: clean (only pre-existing warnings unrelated to this PR — INK_RGB unused, no-img-element in unrelated files). pnpm build: success. pnpm test: 40/40 pass.

No issues found. Implementation is faithful to the plan, well-commented, and minimal.
